_note: Live course-insight sources for the co-pilot and the course panel (api/ai/course_insights). Every URL, TTL and limit lives here; code carries none. Env overrides: COURSE_INSIGHT_<ID>_URL, COURSE_INSIGHT_DISABLED=<id,id>.

suggestion_templates_he._note: Course-panel suggestion chips. A chip is shown only when its signal exists in the course's data; order = priority. {placeholders} are filled from that data.
